_comment: The recall rung requires a journal row proving prior decisions were read
before the work started. That rule was ratified on 2026-08-06. Every feature
listed here already existed by then, so the demand cannot be satisfied
honestly - you cannot recall-before-starting work that has already finished.
Clearing it would mean writing a row asserting a recall that never happened,
and the FSM would then treat that lie as evidence.
Exempt means ONE thing: the recall rung reads satisfied for that feature.
Grounding, deciding, specifying, building and verifying are still checked in
full. Nothing started after the rule belongs here, and the tool never adds to
this list by itself - it only warns when an entry no longer has a brief.
